game_concept: A racing platformer set in Coastal Port – Salt Pans, salt evaporation pans: the harbor master must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Weather Switch: Choose tools by checking weather and terrain conditions each turn.
theme: Coastal Port – Salt Pans: salt evaporation pans
core_gameplay_loop: In Salt Pans, repeat each round: Choose tools by checking weather and terrain conditions each turn. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the harbor master ahead. Then check the gear_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the dock crane by solving code steps involving gear_ok that move the harbor master forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the dock crane first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Weather Switch
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Weather Switch' (Week 3 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Salt Pans'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gear_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Salt Pans.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
